scope: HTTP(S) prerender activation only; ordinary navigation and BFCache scope unchanged
defer: post task before contacting engine, preventing synchronous reply before kDefer
lifetime: navigation-owned condition and weak callbacks; once timer or decision completes invalidate outstanding callback
deny: Stop navigation, no resume, no member access after potential destruction
context: initiator origin available in common params before sanitized referrer initialization
privacy: no new diagnostics or URL logging
